name: knowtether
description: Work with AI to write articles, reports and research reviews with clearer sources and reasoning. Includes KPDM guidance and limited advisory checks.

interface.shortDescription: 和 AI 一起，写得有据、讲得清
interface.longDescription: 知据为用 AI 写文章、报告和研究综述的人提供方法、模板、任务提醒与有限检查。KPDM 全称 Knowledge Product Development Meta-Model（知识产品开发元模型）。当前不保证纠正迎合、事实错误、语法或技术水印，也未可靠实现随包规范自动读取。需要 Python 3.10+，使用前审阅并信任 Hooks。
defaultPrompt: Use KnowTether to draft a grounded knowledge article.
Review this report's claims, sources and limitations.
